segments.english:
11168 — al-Rabadha' bint Amr ibn Imara ibn Atiyya al-Balawiyya (5).

She was previously mentioned in the biographical notice of her client Yasir, under the letter ya', the last of the letters; the vocalization of her name was given there.

(1) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6913.
(2) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6914.
(3) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6916.
(4) In manuscript A: al-'Armani.
(5) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6917; al-Isti'ab, entry 3381.
